title: Alchemy & Transmutation — Stone, Vessel, Fire, Color Stages and Potatoverse Forge
status: historical alchemy + conversation archaeology + project comparison
purpose: Carve alchemy as a historically varied material and symbolic practice before comparing it with Potato/Philosopher's Stone, Forge, Ash, Mud, Clay, Soil, Door and Repair.
epistemic_rule: Historical alchemy/chymistry, modern chemistry, Jungian/psychological readings and Potatoverse mythology are different layers. A symbolic transmutation is not a chemical claim.

historical_core.laboratory_world: European chymists worked with minerals, metals, medicines, pigments, heat, distillation and other transformations while also pursuing chrysopoeia and the philosophers' stone.
historical_core.philosopher_stone: A legendary alchemical agent associated especially with metallic transmutation and, in some traditions, medicine/elixir themes.

chromatic_sequence.caution: The four-color sequence is historically attested but should not be treated as the universal workflow of every alchemical text.

stages.name: Albedo
stages.project_neighbor: Mirror/clarity/source-checking; separation of residue from usable material

stages.name: Rubedo
stages.historical_role: reddening/final maturation in many emblematic accounts

project_conversation_genealogy: 2026-02-03: Potato framed as Philosopher's Stone through hidden endurance, transformation and multiplication.
2026-06-28: 'Philosopher's stone of blood' / reflection-from-chaos and mud→clay formulation.
2026-09-08: Potato contains opposites; Stone sits inside the developmental Seed→Needle→Sprout→Axis sequence.

process_grammar.raw_material: prima-materia-like project position = unresolved mixed potential, not a claim of one historical alchemical substance
process_grammar.vessel: bounded transformation context; compare with House/Body/Vessel only when containment conditions are explicit
process_grammar.fire: process intensity/heat; compare with Forge, not with moral goodness
process_grammar.dissolution: loss of existing form or release from rigid structure
process_grammar.fixation: stabilization so the new configuration persists
process_grammar.multiplication: capacity of transformed output to reproduce/seed further transformation

potatoverse_crosswalk.stone: Potato/Stone = compressed transformable potential and integrator of opposites in project mythology
potatoverse_crosswalk.mud_to_clay: unresolved mixture becomes formable material when context, pressure and intention create structure
potatoverse_crosswalk.forge: pressure/heat/process; constructive only if followed by cooling, integration and increased capability
potatoverse_crosswalk.ash: residue after rupture; may enter Mud/Strife or Soil/repair
potatoverse_crosswalk.rubedo_boundary: Project 'red activation' is a modern internal mapping, not proof that historical rubedo encoded Tim/Potato mythology.

tests: What vessel or boundary contains transformation?
Which evidence shows a genuine state change rather than relabeling?
Does the output create future independent Seed/capability?
